buySellOrder.question: Is there a specific order to buying and selling on your turn?
buySellOrder.answer: Sell then buy, or buy then sell.

firstSellRound.question: When can you first sell shares in a company?
firstSellRound.answer: From the second stock round onwards.

sameCompanyBuySell.question: Can you buy a certificate and immediately sell a certificate in the same company?

companyBuyShares.question: Can companies buy shares?
companyBuyShares.answer: Privates, in ORs, once a 3 train has been sold. May also buy one private at face value in the first OR of the game.

initialTile.question: Where can you make an initial tile lay?

tileReplacement.question: Must a tile replacement extend existing track?

twoStationsOneTile.question: Can one train run to two stations on the same tile?

maxRevenue.question: Must the maximum possible revenue be claimed?
maxRevenue.answer: Yes. Stockholders of the operating company may point out a higher revenue total than that claimed, which must then be taken.

privateTradeCompany.question: Are private companies purchasable by share companies?
privateTradeCompany.answer: Once a 3 train has been sold. May also be bought at face value in the first OR of the game.

miscellaneous.question: Miscellaneous
miscellaneous.answer: Companies may buy one private company from one player at face value in the game's first operating round. When the fourth (of five) 3 train is purchased, the American Civil War is triggered. In the next operating round, each company loses the income from one of its trains. If a company only owns one train, the company price does not fall due to its failure to pay dividends in this round. When the second (last) 6 train is purchased, 4 trains in the bank pool are removed from play while 4 trains in company hands are desginated as obsolete. Each obsolete train remains in play until after the next time the company runs its trains, when it is removed from play. Three optional rules are included: a) Allow each company the option to lay three yellow tiles on its first operating turn.  b) Allow a company to purchase a private company from a player any time durig phase 2, from $1 to face value.  c) When 3 trains are removed from play, the owning company immediately received a salvage value of $30 per 3 train.
